lua:local m=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.INVITE_FRIENDS_INFOS) m:loadInviteInfos(function(code) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-invite-384-'..tostring(code)) end end)

lua:local m=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.INVITE_FRIENDS_INFOS) local code=m:getInviteCode() if type(code)~='string' or code=='' then error('vc-invite-code') end local friends=m:getInviteFriends() if type(friends)~='table' or #friends~=1 then error('vc-invite-friends-'..tostring(#(friends or {}))) end local peer=friends[1] if tonumber(peer.lev)~=50 then error('vc-invite-peer-lev-'..tostring(peer.lev)) end if tonumber(peer.partner_num)~=1 then error('vc-invite-peer-partner-'..tostring(peer.partner_num)) end if type(peer.player_name)~='string' or type(peer.region_name)~='string' or type(peer.avatar_id)~='number' then error('vc-invite-peer-shape') end local mission=nil for _,row in ipairs(m:getInviteMissions()) do if tonumber(row.mission_id)==100016 then mission=row end end if not mission or mission.can_award~=true then error('vc-invite-100016-not-claimable') end if not __vc_384 or __vc_384.code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-invite-384-capture') end

lua:__vc_385={} local m=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.INVITE_FRIENDS_INFOS) m:getMissionReward({mission_id=100016}, function(code,reply) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-invite-385-'..tostring(code)) end if type(reply.awards)~='table' or #reply.awards~=1 then error('vc-invite-awards-shape') end local row=reply.awards[1] if tonumber(row.crystal)~=90 or tonumber(row.item_num)~=90 then error('vc-invite-awards-value') end if type(reply.new_infos)~='table' or type(reply.new_infos.missions)~='table' then error('vc-invite-new-infos') end for _,r in ipairs(reply.new_infos.missions) do if tonumber(r.mission_id)==100016 and r.can_award~=false then error('vc-invite-claim-not-cleared') end end end)
